biography: Ricardo Haag's story begins on the sun-baked streets of Porto Alegre, Brazil, far from the glitz of international circuits. He grew up tinkering with his grandfather's old Volkswagen Beetle, the very car that would spark his racing obsession. His entry into motorsports was unconventional – local Copa Fusca races, fiercely competitive and unforgiving. A defining moment came at the 2015 Interlagos round, where, starting from the back, he clawed his way to victory after a daring last-corner overtake. That race cemented his reputation as a fearless competitor. Despite offers from higher-tier series, Ricardo remains loyal to Copa Fusca, a decision many see as limiting his potential. Currently, he's chasing his fifth championship title, proving that passion and dedication can thrive even outside the spotlight.
drivingStyle: Haag's driving style is a visceral blend of aggression and precision. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and a willingness to push his car, and sometimes his opponents, to the absolute limit. Tire management isn't his strongest suit; he often sacrifices early-race pace for a blistering final stint. Under pressure, Ricardo thrives, exhibiting a remarkable ability to maintain focus and extract maximum performance when it matters most. His aggressive style often leads to spectacular overtakes, but also occasional collisions.

rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track rivalry fueled by numerous close calls and accusations of unsportsmanlike conduct. Their contrasting driving styles – Vieira's smooth, calculated approach versus Haag's aggressive tactics – often lead to sparks.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue t-shirt under his racing suit.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being the fastest; it's about having the biggest heart."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Copa Fusca Championship after a season-long battle with his arch-rival, Isabela Vieira, securing the title by a single point in the final race.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the 2020 Interlagos round due to a mechanical failure, costing him valuable championship points and leading to a heated exchange with his team.
